channel.title: Carat Capital — The Trade Paper of the Jewelry World
channel.description: Prices, intelligence and analysis from every desk of the stone trade: diamonds, gold and metals, gemstones, watches, auctions, retail and technology.

item.title: Richemont jewellery sales rise 19% at constant rates in the half
item.description: The Maisons' operating result rose to €3.2 billion from €2.5 billion, a 35.3% margin, or 33.4% excluding one-time items. Group sales were €12.3 billion in the six months to 30 September.

item.title: Sotheby's says Romanov sapphire bracelet sold for over CHF 4.1m
item.description: AP reports the 197.80-carat sapphire, estimated at CHF 850,000 to 1.7 million, went to a private collector in Geneva on 11 November. AP gives the price without saying whether it includes the buyer's premium.

item.title: OR Royalties Q3 revenue rises 26% on 0.4% fewer gold ounces
item.description: Revenue reached $90.2 million as the realised gold price averaged $4,304 an ounce, against $3,434. Net earnings were $55.4 million, against a 2025 quarter that included a $54.4 million one-off gain.

item.title: Bulgari Pink diamond sells for CHF 12,086,000 at Christie's Geneva
item.description: The 24.00-carat Fancy Intense Pink ring, unseen for more than seven decades according to Christie's, was the last lot of the 10 November sale. The house gave the price as US$14,809,761.

item.title: Fossil Q3 gross margin climbs to 59.8% as net sales rise 0.4%
item.description: Net income was $11.7 million against a $39.9 million loss a year earlier, in the quarter to 3 October. The company raised its full-year net sales outlook to a range of $980 million to $990 million.

item.title: Kalyan Jewellers half-year revenue rises 38% to Rs 20,912 crore
item.description: Profit after tax rose 48% to Rs 776 crore in the six months to 30 September, unaudited results show. Second-quarter revenue grew 31%, slower than the June quarter's 46%.

item.title: Lazurde nine-month revenue rises 29.3%, 6.1% without gold
item.description: Net profit was SAR 0.2 million against a SAR 16.8 million loss in the nine months to 30 September, preliminary results show. Third-quarter retail revenue fell 4.4%.

item.title: Lab-grown 1-carat average asks 82.5% below natural on CaratRadar
item.description: The online average asking prices read $643 and $3,680 on 11 November. At the trade, the range Lepdo's 24 July vendor guide expects sits 79.9% to 88.3% below IDEX's 11 November round, on different specifications.

item.title: Botswana would double its De Beers stake to 30%, its president says
item.description: President Duma Boko told parliament the state's 15% would rise once the Penny-led consortium buys Anglo American's shares. Anglo says binding documents are still to be agreed.

item.title: Watches of Switzerland Group half-year revenue rises 15% to £974m
item.description: Growth was the same at constant currency, the trading update shows. The US made more than half of sales in the 26 weeks to 1 November, and the group lifted the floor of its guidance.

item.title: Phillips Kashmir sapphire ring hammers 18.9% below its low estimate
item.description: The 16.40-carat ring sold for CHF 1,935,000 with premium on a CHF 1.5 million hammer in Geneva on 9 November. Phillips puts its Geneva Jewels Auction VII at CHF 8,069,595, with 91 of 125 lots sold.

item.title: Christie's says Geneva watch sale made CHF 47.8m, 100% sold
item.description: The Rare Watches auction on 9 November drew registrants from 66 countries, the house says. Its top lot, an F.P. Journe Vagabondage in pink gold, sold for CHF 2,536,000.

item.title: Barrick's Q3 all-in sustaining cost rises 24% to $1,911 an ounce
item.description: The cost was $1,538 a year earlier. Barrick produced 816,000 ounces in the third quarter and realised $4,243 an ounce; attributable output was 2% lower on the year.

item.title: Cartier Portico No. 4 sells for CHF 4.8m, 22.5% above No. 3
item.description: The 1924 mystery clock hammered at CHF 3.9 million against a CHF 3.6 million high estimate at Phillips in Geneva. The house says every lot in the two-day sale sold, and calls the clock a Cartier record.

item.title: Hong Kong jewelry and watch sales rise 20.3% on the year in September
item.description: The category, which also covers clocks and gifts, sold HK$4,706 million on provisional figures, up on a year earlier but below August's figure. Over nine months it is the fastest-growing outlet type in the government's table.

item.title: Noel Tata retires as Titan vice-chairman on 12 November
item.description: Titan's board also approved Price Waterhouse as auditor for five years from the 2027 annual meeting, after B S R & Co.'s second term. Shareholders must still approve the appointment.

item.title: Phillips Geneva sells a Journe at CHF 8.68m and a Patek at CHF 6.27m
item.description: Lot 7, a 2002 F.P. Journe Résonance, hammered at CHF 7.1 million against an estimate of more than CHF 1 million, before buyer's premium. The 1945 Patek hammered at CHF 5.1 million against a CHF 4 million high estimate.

item.title: Chow Tai Seng's nine-month franchise income falls 67.84% on the year
item.description: Franchise income was RMB 1.076bn, 19.27% of revenue against 49.39% a year earlier. Own stores and e-commerce made 78% of revenue in the first nine months, Huaxia Times reports from the filing.

item.title: Rexhep Rexhepi's Chronograph Flyback wins the 2026 Aiguille d'Or
item.description: The GPHG gave twenty prizes in Geneva on 7 November. Audemars Piguet, Chopard and Ferdinand Berthoud each won two, and Patek Philippe took the Special Jury Prize for its Watch Art Grand Exhibition.

item.title: China's gold reserves rise 830,000 oz in October, a 24th month
item.description: SAFE data put reserves at 78.30 million ounces, about 2,435.4 tonnes, at the end of October. Eastmoney calls it the largest monthly addition since buying restarted in November 2024.

item.title: Burgundy Diamond Mines ends September with A$596,000 in cash
item.description: Its quarterly cash-flow report shows A$11.67 million at the start of the quarter and, asked to estimate its funding, says none is available. Burgundy says the Ekati receiver reports that mining has ceased.

item.title: 197.80-carat Romanov sapphire leads Sotheby's Geneva royal sale
item.description: Sotheby's Royal and Noble Jewels sale closes on 11 November, led by the sapphire mounted by Cartier. JCK and National Jeweler report a Sotheby's estimate of CHF 850,000 to 1.7 million.

item.title: Titan's Q2 pre-tax profit rises 53%, 18% excluding customs gains
item.description: Profit before tax was about ₹2,329 crore in the quarter to 30 September, on total income of about ₹20,533 crore, up 25%. Excluding ₹536 crore of customs-duty gains, it was about ₹1,793 crore.

item.title: Fancy Color Diamond Index eases 0.1% in Q3, 0.5% below a year ago
item.description: Pink diamonds edged up in the third quarter while blue eased 0.2% and yellow 0.4%, the Fancy Color Research Foundation says. Fancy Vivid Pink, the grade that led, rose 1.0%.

item.title: Bonhams estimates an F.P. Journe Souscription at €700,000 to €1.2m
item.description: Bonhams shows two F.P. Journe watches in Geneva on 5 and 6 November ahead of its Paris Fine Watches sale on 19 November. The second watch, a Chronomètre à Résonance, is estimated at €300,000 to €600,000.

item.title: Brilliant Earth Q3 orders rise 5.6%, average order value falls 3.1%
item.description: Orders were 52,720 against 49,910, while average order value fell to $2,140 from $2,209 in the quarter to 30 September. Net sales were $112.8m, and the company forecasts full-year 2026 growth of 2.75% to 4% on 2025's $437m.

item.title: Royal Gold's Q3 revenue rises 84% to $464.8m, debt cleared in October
item.description: Operating cash flow reached a record $344.4m on 109,000 gold-equivalent ounces sold, against 72,900 a year earlier. The last $150m on its credit facility was repaid on 19 October.

item.title: China's nine-month jewellery gold falls 33.86% on year, bars up 26.26%
item.description: The China Gold Association put January-to-September consumption at 684.623 tonnes, up 0.28% on the year, in figures carried by Xinhua. Jewellery took 178.612 tonnes and bars and coins 444.576 tonnes.

item.title: Pandora reports 6% Q3 organic growth and narrows 2026 guidance
item.description: Third-quarter revenue was DKK 6,694 million against 6,269 million a year earlier, with like-for-like growth of 4%. Guidance is now 2-3% organic growth, previously 0-3%, and an EBIT margin of 22.5-23%, previously 22-23%.

item.title: Gem Diamonds' Letšeng averages $1,945 a carat in Q3, up 73% on year
item.description: Gem Diamonds sold 17,899 carats from Letšeng in the third quarter for $34.8m, against 22,830 carats and $25.7m a year earlier. Four stones above $1m each brought in $22.2m, and the miner raised its 2026 guidance.
